name: Database Query Optimizer Developer
description: Implement query planners, cost estimators, and execution engines. Understand relational algebra, join algorithms, and index selection.
example_snippet:
program QueryPlan:
    shape PlanNode holds:
        method next produces truth value:
            produce success with false
        end method
    end shape

    shape ScanNode is a PlanNode holds:
        TableName as text
        CurrentRow as whole number

        method next produces truth value:
            put the sum of CurrentRow and 1 into CurrentRow
            produce success with true
        end method
    end shape

    shape FilterNode is a PlanNode holds:
        Child as unique handle to PlanNode
        Predicate as text

        method next produces truth value:
            keep HasNext as truth value
            call Child.next giving HasNext
            produce success with HasNext
        end method
    end shape

    keep Scan as unique handle to ScanNode with new ScanNode with "users" and 0
    keep Filter as unique handle to FilterNode with new FilterNode with Scan and "age > 18"

    keep Row as truth value
    call Filter.next giving Row
    print the text "Got row: " and Row and newline
end program
